text: A Song of Ascents. Blessed{H835} is every one that feareth{H3373} Jehovah,{H3068} That walketh{H1980} in his ways.{H1870}
For thou shalt eat{H398} the labor{H3018} of thy hands:{H3709} Happy{H835} shalt thou be, and it shall be well{H2896} with thee.
Thy wife{H802} shall be as a fruitful{H6509} vine,{H1612} In the innermost parts{H3411} of thy house;{H1004} Thy children{H1121} like olive{H2132} plants,{H8363} Round about{H5439} thy table.{H7979}
Behold, thus shall the man{H1397} be blessed{H1288} That feareth{H3373} Jehovah.{H3068}
Jehovah{H3068} bless{H1288} thee out of Zion:{H6726} And see{H7200} thou the good{H2898} of Jerusalem{H3389} all the days{H3117} of thy life.{H2416}
Yea, see{H7200} thou thy children's{H1121} children.{H1121} Peace{H7965} be upon Israel.{H3478}
